case.title: Search is case-sensitive regression
case.summary: Regression: product search became case-sensitive after commit 649b24a ("perf(catalog): memoize search index") silently removed .toLowerCase() normalization from both the search needle and haystack while refactoring to add index memoization. Fixed by restoring .toLowerCase() on both the haystack (in indexFor) and the needle (in searchProducts), preserving the memoization. Full suite 117/117 green, repro test confirmed RED then GREEN.

plainSummary.text: The product search was behaving like a strict match, only returning items that exactly matched the case used in the search query, so searching for "mug" would miss products containing "Mug" or "MUG". This regression was caused by a recent performance optimization that removed the code which previously converted both the search term and the catalog entries to lower case before comparison, restoring sensitivity to upper and lower case differences. The fix restores the toLowerCase() normalization on both the search query and the catalog entries being searched, ensuring the search remains case-insensitive and returns expected results regardless of the casing used in the search term.

events.title: Historian agent started — investigating case-sensitivity regression in product search
Git log and blame analysis complete — culprit identified

data.finding: Neither needle nor haystack is lowercased before the substring match. The index builds haystack once and caches it without normalisation. The search test suite (tests/catalog/search.test.ts) only queries with exact-case strings (e.g. 'Mug', 'Kitchen') so the regression was not caught by existing tests.

data.subject: perf(catalog): memoize search index
data.author: GegarinSagolsem
data.notes: Removed .toLowerCase() from both needle and haystack during refactoring for memoized index. Also changed JSDoc from 'Case-insensitive' to 'Substring search'.

data.result: 117 passed / 0 failed. Repro test GREEN, no regressions.

reasons: Repro test genuinely encodes the bug

data.expected: Product search is case-insensitive: searching 'mug', 'Mug', or 'MUG' all return 'Ceramic Coffee Mug'
data.actual: Product search is case-sensitive: only exact-case queries match. 'mug' returns 0 results, 'KITCHEN' returns 0 results, 'bluetooth' returns 0 results.
stepsToReproduce: Observe 'No products match mug.' instead of Ceramic Coffee Mug

callers: indexFor() in src/catalog/search.ts (builds haystack without normalization)
data.notes: The bug is isolated to the .includes() call on line 25 of src/catalog/search.ts. Neither the needle (user query) nor the haystack (product name + category) is lowercased before comparison. All commits after initial commit are unrelated to search.ts.
